units.source_text: 对我来说，战败无非就是这种绝望的体验。

en.t: For me, defeat in the war was nothing other than this kind of experience of despair.

units.source_text: 至今我眼前依然看见8月15日如火焰般的夏日的光。

en.t: Even now, before my eyes, I can still see the fiery summer light of August 15.

units.source_text: 人们说所有的价值都崩溃了，可我心中却相反，

en.t: People said that all values had collapsed, but in my heart it was the opposite,

units.source_text: 主张"永远"觉醒、复苏并拥有其权利。

en.t: I insisted that "eternity" had awakened, revived, and possessed its rights.

units.source_text: 这"永远"说明金阁在那里是永恒的存在。

en.t: This "eternity" showed that the Golden Pavilion existed there as something everlasting.
